hero.subtitle: The IUC edition of the AWS Student Community Day.
hero.descriptionP3: team, the Denver Campus in Douala becomes the cloud ground zero in Cameroon. A full day of hands-on labs, strategic networking, and career-changing connections.

about.title: About
about.p1: AWS Student Builder Groups are student communities that foster learning by doing. At AWS SCD, we prioritize hands-on labs, real-world demos, and collaborative projects to turn theory into actionable skills.
about.p2: Organized by IUC students and backed by the AWS ecosystem, the AWS SCD aims to build a local talent pool ready to tackle Cloud and AI challenges.

labs.title: Hands-on Labs
labs.desc: Get your hands dirty. Generative AI with Amazon Bedrock, Serverless architectures, DevSecOps pipelines — guided labs on real AWS accounts, not just slides.

network.title: Elite Networking
network.desc: Meet professionals, tech companies, and recruiters from Cameroon and Central Africa. The connections you make here will shape your career path.

career.title: Cloud Career
career.desc: A direct bridge between academia and industry. Pathway guidance for AWS Solutions Architect and Cloud Practitioner certifications, plus access to internships and job roles.

card1.desc: After the remarkable Douala and Eyang editions, the momentum is on. AWS SBG IUC writes the next chapter of cloud history in Central Africa.

card4.desc: Denver Campus Student Builders prove that technical excellence knows no geographical boundaries. IUC is the engine.

faq.desc: Seats are limited. Register now to receive all practical information, full agenda and lab access.

items.a: Yes, completely free for all students. Registration is mandatory and seats are limited. The pass covers all labs, talks, lunch, and a welcome kit.

items.q: Do I need to be an AWS expert to attend?
items.a: Not at all. The event welcomes all skill levels, from total beginners to senior developers. Labs are designed with a progressive learning curve. You only need curiosity and motivation.

items.q: Will there be certifications or badges?
items.a: Yes. Official AWS SBG IUC participation certificates will be awarded. Credly digital badging for completed labs is also planned. Orientation sessions on AWS certifications will be run on-site.

items.q: Should I bring my own laptop?
items.a: A laptop is recommended for hands-on labs. If you don't have one, a limited number of shared workstations will be available. Make sure to bring a charged battery!

items.q: Is the event restricted to IUC students?
items.a: No! Although organized by AWS SBG IUC and hosted at the Denver Campus, it is open to all students in Douala and Cameroon, regardless of their university. Professionals looking to network are also welcome.

items.q: How to become a sponsor or partner?
items.a: Check our Sponsoring section or contact the team directly at awscloudclubiuc@gmail.com. We offer packages fitting all budgets, including in-kind partnerships.
